answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 65185 Country: India Title: Relationship between husband and wife Question: If a person goes abroad and returns after 8 years and in between he does not have phone or any media contact between them and now he came back and he is with his wife, is this relationship halal? Can he continue his married life or he should do remarriage with her again? Please reply soon with a Hadith. Answer ID: 65185 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 727/679/SN=07/1437) If during this period the husband has not given any talaq then their nikah is still intact. Both can live with each other as husband and wife without renewal of nikah, there is no place for doubt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
